pages.title: Speaker ID
pages.text: Matching non-empty IDs share playback within one dimension.$(br2)Blank IDs are standalone.$(br2)Display name is an optional label for listings and commands; it does not control linking.

pages.title: Proxy outputs
pages.text: Proxies follow the linked playback timeline.$(br2)Their volume, range and distance fade are independent.$(br2)They inherit directional settings but aim from their own front face.
